name: adv_active_bad
title: Pool-based active learning that acquires from the test split - eight planted defects
note: The counterpart to `adv_advanced_clean/curriculum.py`, which re-splits its own training rows every round and is NOT a leak. Here the acquisition pool is the test split itself, so every round promotes 200 held-out rows into the labelled set and by round eight the model has been fitted on most of its own test set. MLView reports the two sklearn-shaped leaks (MLV101, MLV102) and the two hygiene findings, and it declares the rest: two `untagged_dataflow` rows name `x_labelled` (a parameter of active_round) and `x_train` by name and say leakage through them is neither confirmed nor ruled out - which is the honest answer for the acquisition leak itself.

expected.defect: StandardScaler is fitted on every row before train_test_split at line 39
expected.why: the test rows' mean and variance are baked into the transform the model trains through, so the held-out score is optimistic before the active loop even starts

expected.defect: the scaler is re-fitted on x_test inside the acquisition loop
expected.why: the transform is learned from the held-out rows once per round, so the leak compounds with every acquisition

expected.defect: roc_auc_score is fed model.predict(x_test), which is hard class labels
expected.why: the AUC collapses to a rescaled accuracy and stops being a ranking measure at all
the pool and the test set are different on every run, so two runs of the same acquisition curve are not comparable
the split, the forest's bootstrap and the tie-breaking inside argsort all move between runs

forbidden.why: there is no temporal signal anywhere: no pd.to_datetime, no parse_dates=, no sort_values on a date column and no statsmodels/prophet import
there is no torch DataLoader in this project
there is no torch model here at all; MLV301 declares frameworks=["torch"] and a RandomForestClassifier has no .eval()
same: there is nothing for torch.no_grad() to wrap
the only accuracy-family metric is absent; the metric in this file is roc_auc_score, which is in MLV305's score-metrics carve-out

unsupported.defect: the acquisition pool passed to active_round IS the test split, so every round moves 200 held-out rows into the labelled training set
unsupported.why: MLV107 (test set used for model selection or early stopping) is a later-tier rule that is not built, and no rule models a row-level transfer between splits. MLView declares the gap: `untagged_dataflow` names `x_labelled` at line 56 as a parameter with no dataflow tag and says leakage through it is neither confirmed nor ruled out.

unsupported.defect: cross_val_score is given the bare RandomForestClassifier over a matrix that was already fit_transformed, so the scaling is not refit per fold
unsupported.why: MLV103 requires the FIT_TRANSFORM call to be earlier in the SAME function as the CV call; here the fit_transform is in prepare() and the cross_val_score is in main().

unsupported.defect: the estimator is refitted from scratch inside the acquisition loop while the caller keeps using the same object to score the pool, so round N's acquisition is made by round N-1's model on rows round N will train on
unsupported.why: no rule models the acquisition/refit ordering of an active-learning loop.

unsupported.defect: none - the target column IS removed from the feature matrix here
unsupported.why: recorded so the absence is deliberate: MLV105 (target left inside the feature matrix) is a later-tier rule that is not built, so it cannot be a `forbidden` row - `test_every_labelled_code_is_a_real_rule` only accepts registered codes.
